name: Hero Clash
summary:
Hero Clash is an epic mobile strategy RPG where you collect and awaken powerful hero cards to build the ultimate team. Equip your heroes with legendary gear, rare artifacts, and customizable talents to maximize their potential on the battlefield.

Take on thrilling PvE adventures, intense PvP battles, and massive boss fights. Challenge yourself in dynamic game modes like Adventure Mode, Boss Raids, and more.

Join a Union to team up with friends and allies — cooperate, strategize, and grow stronger together. Whether you're climbing the ranks or exploring the world, teamwork is key to progressing in Hero Clash.

Lots of levels are waiting for you! Come and save the continent torn apart by the evil void and explore a world full of danger and mystery!
